protocol: equal geometry; MDAnalysis H5MD full traj (positions each frame) vs h5py load of position/value only vs readcon CON full frames (uncompressed + gzip + optional zstd) vs readcon.read_chemfiles multi-frame XYZ

apples_notes.mda_h5md: Universe + iterate all frames + .positions (MDA Python API)
apples_notes.h5py_positions: raw HDF5 dataset load only — not symbols/cell/constraints/atom_id/JSON
apples_notes.readcon_con: full ConFrame parse (payload richer than coords array)
apples_notes.readcon_con_gz: transparent gzip decompress + full ConFrame parse (always-on surface; not mmap)
apples_notes.readcon_con_zst: transparent zstd decompress + full ConFrame parse (optional --features zstd); null if unavailable
apples_notes.size_note: CON text multi-frame concat compresses strongly when frames are identical/near-identical (rare-event checkpoint pattern). H5MD here is positions-only; CON carries full header/constraints/ids.
